description: Signal Engine embedding benchmark queries with HUMAN-AUTHORED relevance labels (no LLM was used to assign relevance). Each query targets the corpus of the same version. relevant is a list of {id, grade}: grade 2 = the passage directly answers the query; grade 1 = the passage is partially relevant / useful context. A passage not listed is judged not relevant. 'pattern' records the retrieval challenge the query is meant to exercise.
